summary: preinstall script exfiltrates OS username to Beeceptor endpoint
details: The package's preinstall.js lifecycle script executes `whoami` via child_process.execSync and sends the captured OS username to the hardcoded endpoint https://erhantest-erhan.free.beeceptor.com via an HTTPS GET with the username in the query string. This runs automatically on `npm install` before any user code executes. Beeceptor is a third-party request-inspection service; the subdomain is an anonymous tenant unrelated to any legitimate publisher. The package has no documented purpose that would justify transmitting the installer's identity to this destination.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
